scientific_integrity: Proof gives an exact Gram reduction, a Hilbert-space inverse-Gram limit and Fourier extremizers. Numerical evidence is auxiliary and not a proof. Unproved extensions are expressly excluded.
scientific_limitations: Fixed number of summands, fixed interior collision center, scalar coefficients and Hilbert–Schmidt norm only. No generalized-weight, other-Schatten-exponent, or simultaneous boundary limit is claimed. Standard Hardy interpolation supplies essential ingredients. Possible equivalent unindexed work and inaccessible older full papers remain priority risks.
title: Sharp Schatten-two collision conditioning for Fock dilations
